claim_boundary: Company recall per family over the published contract envelopes; the rubric's claim-recall half needs the official union and is not computed here.

metric_definitions.companies: Distinct organisation numbers in the measured envelopes.
metric_definitions.batch_size: The batch the measurement ran on; the opportunity counts are scaled to it.
metric_definitions.opportunities: Official per-family opportunity counts (companies with a match in the union of all participants' and Builderr's discoveries), scaled to the batch size.
metric_definitions.family_company_recall: Per family: companies publishing at least one claim of that family, the opportunity count, and covered/opportunities.
metric_definitions.scored_family_recall: family_company_recall restricted to the scored families.
metric_definitions.scored_family_recall_proxy_50: Opportunity-weighted mean of the scored families' recall, in points out of 50. The rubric's other half (claim recall against the union) is not computable without the official union, so this is the company-recall half only.
metric_definitions.scored_group_recall: The six decision families (identity, accounts, people, website, hiring, activity), each the opportunity-weighted mean of its official families.
metric_definitions.scored_group_recall_proxy_50: Opportunity-weighted mean of the six decision families' recall, in points out of 50.
metric_definitions.reviews_excluded_from_headline: True: the rubric does not score ratings, reviews or sentiment, and the keyless sources reach at most 32 of the 323 review opportunities.
metric_definitions.claims_without_family: Published claims that carry no family; they count towards no family.
metric_definitions.external_family_company_recall: Per family: companies publishing at least one claim of that family whose evidence comes from a source outside the Norwegian register (data.brreg.no, w2.brreg.no). A claim with no resolvable evidence is not counted as external.
metric_definitions.scored_external_family_recall_proxy_50: The external-only family recalls, opportunity-weighted, in points out of 50. This is the number that tracks external recall: the all-claims variant counts the register's own facts, which every company has.
metric_definitions.external_scored_group_recall: The six decision families, restricted to claims backed by a non-register source.
metric_definitions.scored_external_group_recall_proxy_50: The external-only six decision families, opportunity-weighted, in points out of 50.
